error-handling-reviewer.reason: Language question (is the handler hygienic) versus domain question (does a failure become a measurement); error-handling inlines the deliberate swallows so the two do not both report them.

secrets-reviewer.reason: code-reviewer only posts quotable CLAUDE.md rules and clear bugs; secrets owns key material and credentials.

resource-leak-reviewer.reason: code-reviewer's generic bug list includes leaks; resource-leak owns the terminus-specific resources.

test-coverage-reviewer.reason: pr-test-analyzer judges the quality of tests that exist; test-coverage judges whether a test exists.

local-api-reviewer.reason: Both mention /dev/*: sun-safety owns the guard, local-api owns the exposure.

external-process-reviewer.reason: Both touch app/main; sidecar-lifecycle owns the sidecar spawn, startup timeout and stderr, external-process owns other subprocesses.

test-determinism-reviewer.reason: Both read tests; test-determinism owns clock/network/order dependence, pr-test-analyzer owns assertions that cannot fail.

fitting-validation-reviewer.reason: Both reject plausible wrong numbers; fitting-validation covers fit and estimator logic, strategic-fragility covers failure paths recorded as measurements.
